# mimecast_active_directory_integration (Resource)

Manage a Mimecast Active Directory integration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "active_directory_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "mimecast_active_directory_integration" "example" {
  description                   = "tf-example-active-directory"
  domains                       = ["example.com"]
  hostname                      = "ad1.example.com"
  alternate_hostname            = "ad2.example.com"
  port                          = 636
  user_dn                       = "CN=mimecast,OU=Service Accounts,DC=example,DC=com"
  password_wo                   = var.active_directory_password
  password_wo_version           = 1
  root_dn                       = "DC=example,DC=com"
  encryption_mode               = "strict"
  acknowledge_disabled_accounts = true
  enabled                       = true
  max_unlink                    = "100"
  sync_contacts                 = true
  delete_users                  = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `alternate_hostname` (String) Alternate Active Directory server IP address or hostname.
- `description` (String) Integration description.
- `hostname` (String) Active Directory server IP address or hostname.
- `root_dn` (String) Root distinguished name searched by the integration.
- `user_dn` (String) Distinguished name used to connect to Active Directory.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `acknowledge_disabled_accounts` (Boolean) Whether disabled Active Directory accounts are acknowledged.
- `delete_users` (Boolean) Whether users removed from the directory are deleted from Mimecast.
- `domains` (List of String) Domains synchronised by the integration.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the integration is enabled.
- `encryption_mode` (String) Directory encryption mode.
- `info` (String) Additional integration information.
- `max_unlink` (String) Maximum number of users that one synchronisation may unlink.
- `password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Active Directory password. Write-only; increment password_wo_version when changing it.
- `password_wo_version` (Number) Version trigger for password_wo. Increment this when changing the password.
- `port` (Number) Port used to connect to Active Directory.
- `sync_contacts` (Boolean) Whether contacts are synchronised.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Mimecast Active Directory integration ID.
- `last_sync_date_time` (String) Time of the last directory synchronisation.
- `status` (String) Integration status.
- `sync_running` (Boolean) Whether a directory synchronisation is running.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mimecast_active_directory_integration.example integration-id
```
